name: Popover
label: Popover
description: Contextual overlay panel with click and hover triggers, positioned relative to its anchor.

props.name: content
props.description:
Popover content. Replaces the native `content` attribute, which only
means something on a `<meta>` element.

props.name: surface
props.description:
The panel's surface. `panel` (the default) is the content panel: a
16px inset and the container border. `menu` is DropdownMenu's own
surface (its 4px inset, input border and corner), for a popover that
sits among menus and should read as one of them, such as a table
toolbar's sort or column panel.

props.name: position
props.description: Preferred position. `left` and `right` are screen sides; `start` and `end` follow the reading direction, so `end` opens to the right in English and to the left in Arabic.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the panel lines up with, on the top and bottom sides. `start` and `end` follow the reading direction. Defaults to `start`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popover is open (controlled mode)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popover starts open when uncontrolled

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger and the panel; the panel is named "Popover" when it is omitted

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the popover's root wrapper, which holds the trigger and the panel
